items.claim: Effect card sliders write an undo step per move, because `EffectBody` has no `draftConfig`
The spline Anchors slider's `onInput` commits instead of drafting
Shapes lab params differ from what the shapes really take and default to: ribbon `taperWidth` 12 vs 8, cloud's dead `padding`/`roundness` with no `erosion`, plaque missing `sheenIntensity`
items.note: It relies on f9d687288b, which adds `badgeShapeDefaults`, `badgeBaseDefaults` and `badgeEffectDefaults` to Badge's catalog (minor changeset). A new `paramParity.test.ts` now holds every shape, base and effect table to those defaults.

items.claim: Effect params missing from the panel: spikes `cornerCompensation` , sunbeams `color`, aqua/metal `accent` (A)
items.note: Aqua's `accent` defaults to a theme token, so it gets an "Own accent" switch; off, the param is left unset and the badge picks its own color.

items.claim: Copy JSX writes the label unescaped
A sideways wheel raises an anchor's weight
items.note: A wheel event with zero `deltaY` now also passes the gesture on instead of committing an empty step.

items.claim: In quadrant mode the editor's far end doesn't match the base, after a mode switch or a count change
The spline editor's hit radius is smaller than its heavy dots
Copy JSX also dropped the label offset and the Type section's font settings, so the snippet still didn't match the stage

The scallops effect started at 5/12 in the lab where the effect draws 4/10, and outline's color was hard-coded `#7fb069` where the effect follows `--badge-edge` (outline gets the same "Own color" switch)
